Same model, GPU, engine, build, weights and settings. Prompt speed and time
are wall times, because each engine's own prompt timer leaves out different
things: a server's from request sent to reply received, vLLM's around its
generate call in the same process. The two runs sent the prompt in different
forms (token ids against a chat request). A chat request adds the chat
template and can change how the server splits the prompt. So neither time
says which engine is faster, and no winner is marked.
